title: Billing and Coding: Peripheral Nerve Blocks and Procedures for Chronic Pain

codes.4: CPT codes 62281, 65505, 64418, 64430, 64450, 64505, 64510, *64999, 64624, 64632, 64640, 0440T, 0441T and 0442T are non-covered for pain management. 64999 is to be used to report injections of anesthetic and/or steroids for the facial and phrenic nerves and cervical plexus. This code replaces the deleted codes 64402, 64410 and 64413.
